text:
[Council File 26-0149]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
TRADE, TRAVEL, AND TOURISM COMMITTEE REPORT relative to requesting the Port of Los Angeles to provide a written report on the status of the Goods Movement Training Campus project, including Port of Long Beach participation, proposed location, scope, funding, expenditures, and anticipated next steps.
Recommendations for Council action, pursuant to Motion (McOsker – Hutt):
1. REQUEST the Executive Director, Port of Los Angeles (POLA), to provide a written report on the current status of the Goods Movement Training Campus (GMTC), including the following:
a. The current status of the Port of Long Beach's (POLB) participation in the GMTC, including whether the original agreement between POLA and POLB remains in effect and, if not, whether the agreement was terminated or modified.
b. The current proposal for the GMTC, including the proposed location, scope, timeline, cost, funding plan, and reasons for moving away from the previously proposed Wilmington location.
c. The status of the State's $110 million grant, including the amount received and expended to date, remaining funds, any extensions or modifications to the grant, and the status of required progress reports.
d. A summary of all expenditures and contracts to date, including the AECOM design contract, current staffing and outside-service costs, and any other commitments against the project funding.
e. The anticipated next steps, approvals, and timeline for advancing the project, including coordination with labor, industry, community stakeholders, POLB, and other governmental partners.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
